blocks.title: One function, three questions
blocks.problem: For $f(x)=x^3-3x$ on $[0,2]$, find the absolute minimum, find an MVT input, and decide whether there is an interior inflection.
blocks.answer: Minimum $-2$ at $1$, MVT point $2/\sqrt3$, no interior inflection.

steps.title: MVT
steps.md: A polynomial satisfies the hypotheses. The secant slope is 1, so $3c^2-3=1$ gives $c=2/\sqrt3$.
